title: Briefing for 2026-10-11
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-11: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession. Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor. Inflation on many everyday items was entirely due to tariffs, NY Fed says. Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023. ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies. Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva.
global: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal. Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'. Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky calls it a gift to Putin. Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices. Boots has a new owner: Three ways it could affect you. Burnham promises to curb non-compete rules in job contracts.
philippines: With power bills already high, Meralco wins approval to raise own fees after 15 years. LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. #CourageON: A river in Cebu remembers. Who is Jeus Yape and what is virtual taekwondo?.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
